# DeathPush

> A standalone desktop Git client that replicates the VS Code Source Control UX.

## About

DeathPush is an open-source desktop Git client. It is the VS Code Source Control workflow without the full VS Code application. Review, stage, commit, and manage branches locally. No account and no telemetry.

DeathPush can review repository changes produced by coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. It does not integrate with those tools.

## Key Features

- VS Code Source Control UX with file-level staging
- Monaco diffs with syntax highlighting, side-by-side or unified views, and editing of unstaged files
- Side-by-side image diffs for PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG, and more
- Branch create, switch, merge, rebase, rename, delete, push, and pull
- Current-line blame in the status bar, plus file history and commit diffs
- Merge continue or abort, and rebase continue, skip, or abort when conflicts stop the operation
- Stash, tags, cherry-pick, and reset
- Multi-window repositories, each with its own branches and state
- Built-in themes, including dark, light, and high-contrast variants
- Hybrid Git engine: git2 for reads, native git CLI for writes so hooks, signing, credentials, SSH, and LFS keep working
- Native desktop app on Tauri, Rust, Solid, and Monaco

## Technical Details

- License: Apache-2.0
- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux
- Packages: macOS universal .dmg and .app.tar.gz; Windows .msi and .exe for x64 and ARM; Linux AppImage, .deb, and .rpm for x64 and ARM
- Local operation. No telemetry, no accounts.
- Build prerequisites: Vite+ (vp) with Node.js 24 and pnpm, Rust edition 2024 (minimum rustc 1.85.0), and just
